Container cucumbers! (My first time growing something)

Awesome! You'll catch the bug, especially with cukes; they are PROLIFIC.

The only thing i can recommend, is to get some larger containers. Maybe next year, maybe transplant these. (if you do transplant, try to disturb the rootball as little as possible.) My cukes normally run at least 10 to 15 feet along the ground. They say that the root mass of a plant is approximately the same size as the visible plant above ground, so rootbound might be an issue.

they will apparently climb trellises too, so if they are on a porch or deck with some lattice, they might like climbing that :)

Good luck, and keep on growin!!!

The two in the large pot that are small and the one in the smaller pot are the ones that I had to move around. I do have one more pot but I'm worried that if I try to move the plants again I might kill them.
